inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Cycle diagram: reduced vitamin K (hydroquinone) → γ-glutamyl carboxylase activates clotting factors II, VII, IX, X, proteins C/S → vitamin K epoxide → reductase (VKOR) recycles; warfarin blocks the reductase

notes: The vitamin K cycle is an original KYP adaptation of the source's epoxide-reductase activation → γ-carboxylation cofactor → recycling logic, with warfarin's blockade drawn on the activation step and the deficiency strip (neonatal ↑PT/↑aPTT with normal bleeding time).
